<description>
The [code](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/152a55397e451fed9c10041bddf01aa6839847d5/src/wallet/migrate.cpp#L745) in `BerkeleyRODatabase::Backup()` relies on `copy_file()` with `overwrite_existing` working.

Upstream fixes:
- https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/commit/017e3f89b081e4828a588a3bd27b5feacea042b7
- https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/commit/35c98149a5c7af9159fa7615d8d827b3aaa3cc97
- https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/commit/8b3e47b4099f319e38d357f7c646f51040a13d6e

Suggested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36271#issuecomment-5794127014.

[Here](https://github.com/hebasto/bitcoin/actions/runs/39924174253/job/120344755756#step:10:1943) is an example of the failure when cross-compiling for Windows using GCC 14.2.0:

<patch>
diff --git a/src/test/fs_tests.cpp b/src/test/fs_tests.cpp
index 7fd1de00e0..72956dd93f 100644
--- a/src/test/fs_tests.cpp
+++ b/src/test/fs_tests.cpp
@@ -139,4 +139,30 @@ BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(rename)
     fs::remove(path2);
 }
 
+// Catches a libstdc++ bug on Windows (fixed in GCC 13.4/14.3/15.1, never
+// in 12.x) where copy_file() with overwrite_existing wrongly fails with
+// file_exists for a distinct destination file.
+BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(copy_file_overwrite_existing)
+{
+    const fs::path tmpfolder{m_args.GetDataDirBase()};
+
+    const fs::path path1{tmpfolder / "a"};
+    const fs::path path2{tmpfolder / "b"};
+
+    const std::string path1_contents{"1111"};
+    const std::string path2_contents{"2222"};
+
+    std::ofstream{path1.std_path()} << path1_contents;
+    std::ofstream{path2.std_path()} << path2_contents;
+
+    BOOST_CHECK(fs::copy_file(path1, path2, fs::copy_options::overwrite_existing));
+
+    {
+        std::ifstream file{path2.std_path()};
+        std::string contents;
+        file >> contents;
+        BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL(contents, path1_contents);
+    }
+}
+
 BOOST_AUTO_TEST_SUITE_END()

</patch>
(Diff from merge base to head, smallest files first.)
